maya: Quick sync — I finished conversion of model-x1 to safetensors + bf16 shards. Uploaded to s3://redwood-models/onboard/model-x1/conv-17895/. Can someone sanity-check shard layout and tokenizer mapping? Tokenizer shows a 1-off on <unk> at vocab idx 502. Also config.json lists tensor_parallel: 2 but weights are sharded into 4 files. Not sure if the TP layout is expected. cc @samir @eli

samir: Thanks — I'll run the validation script. Which conversion tool/version did you use?

maya: used safetensors 0.3 + internal convert_v2 (PR #492). CLI: `./convert_v2 --in checkpoint/ --out s3://redwood-models/onboard/model-x1/conv-17895/ --tp 2 --shard-mf 4 --dtype bf16`

eli: quick note — if you passed `--tp 2` but ended up with 4 shards we probably combined tensor-parallel sharding with an additional mirror/shard factor. Can you paste `ls` of the output dir?

maya: sure, here's the dir listing:
```
model-x1-00001.safetensors  model-x1-00002.safetensors
model-x1-00003.safetensors  model-x1-00004.safetensors
tokenizer.json  config.json  README_convert.log
```

ciara: I'm eyeballing the tokenizer — the BPE/vocab looks OK but config.vocab_size=50264 vs tokenizer.json.vocab_size=50265. Probable off-by-one from adding a special token like <pad> or <cls>. Did convert preserve special token order?

maya: convert_v2 has a `--preserve-specials` flag and I set it true, but I might have missed remapping when calling `tokenizer.save_pretrained`. Will re-run a quick dump to check the special token indices.

model-bot: upload complete — s3://redwood-models/onboard/model-x1/conv-17895/ size=48.3GB etag="abc123" (automated)

samir: ran `validate_checkpoint.sh` (local CI). It flagged a KV cache shape mismatch for shard 3: expected (16,64,4096) got (8,64,4096). That implies the TP split isn't matching config axis ordering. Most likely a wrong `tp-axis` assumption during packing.

maya: ack. I'll re-run with different shard options. Does runtime accept 4 shards if config.tensor_parallel=2? I thought runtime maps shards by tensor_parallel *and* shard mirror.

eli: runtime expects `num_tp_shards` to match how attention weights were split across the head dimension. If heads_per_layer % tp_shards != 0 you'll see mismatches. Check `hidden_size` and `num_attention_heads` in config.json. If heads=80 and tp=4 => 20 heads per shard; tp=2 => 40. The KV shape you saw (8 vs 16) suggests head split factor is half what config expects.

ciara: also a reminder about dtype — bf16 is fine, but if someone later tries fp16 we need to ensure `--cast-bias` used: one bias tensor historically stayed fp32 and causes kernel errors. There's a flag in convert_v2 to cast bias.

maya: plan: re-run conversion with `--tp 2 --shard-mirror 2` which will produce 4 files but keep the TP layout as 2 (mirror for IO). I'll also regenerate tokenizer by calling `tokenizer.save_pretrained` after remapping specials and run the full `validate_checkpoint.sh` locally. Will upload and ping.

samir: sounds good. Ping me after upload and I'll run CI and the serve smoke tests. If validation passes I'll merge PR #492.

ciara: small request — please drop a `README.txt` in the s3 folder listing mapping: which file -> TP rank / mirror. Saves time during debug.

maya: will add README and include the exact convert flags and `git rev-parse` commit. Re-running now. thx :thumbsup:
